'''Base D-55''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military base, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. It was commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Dael]].

==History==
After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed, Dantooine was ceded to the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and all Republic military forces were ordered to depart from the planet. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] were dispatched by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to oversee trooper withdrawal. En route, their ship, the [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']], was attacked by a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith warship]]. Master Dar'nala was captured, and eventually killed under torturous interrogation. Shan escaped in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and was later rescued by a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle]] piloted by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Harron Tavus]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Orgus Din]], who were on their way to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].

After arriving on Balmorra, Tavus, Shan and the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Jedi, [[Fortris Gall]] were sent to continue overseeing the troop withdrawal on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Shan and Tavus arrived at Base D-55 and were immediately contacted by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] informing them of the murder of Master [[Zym]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gin Lesl]]. Am-Ris again conveyed how important it was that Base D-55 and Dantooine be abandoned in concordance with the terms of the peace treaty with the Sith. Commander Dael refused to leave, stating that the treaty had already been broken by the Sith Empire. Lieutenant Tavus agreed with him, as did Fortris Gall, who had arrived several hours previously.
